description: Append-only per-process-step attestation for a wafer lot moving through the fab. Each silicon_* Pregel cell super-step writes one record after completing its step. The chain of these records is the wafer lot's process_history used by chipManufacturingAttestation. Per ADR-2605242545 §Decision 1 + 2.

stepIndex.description: Monotonic step number within this lot's process_history.

executingCellDid.description: DID of the silicon_* Pregel cell that performed the super-step.

equipmentDid.description: DID of the equipment unit that ran the recipe.

recipeUri.description: AT URI of the recipe record (versioned).

telemetryUri.description: Optional. AT URI of the fabEquipmentTelemetry down-sample for this step.

metrologyUri.description: Optional. If this step is metrology, AT URI of the defect classification result. If non-metrology, may reference the most recent prior metrology.

outcomeNarrative.description: Required when outcome != 'ok'. Documents the deviation and the operator/cell decision.

silenForceReviewUri.description: Required when processStep ∈ {'litho', 'implant'} (HIGH §2(a)(c) risk per ADR-2605242545 §Decision 1).
